Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Sorrells
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 384 as introduced could increase receipts to the Alabama Board of Electrical Contractors Fund in the State Treasury by an undetermined amount dependent upon any additional civil penalties issued by the board of up to $5,000 as provided in this bill.
Further, this bill codifies the current practice of the Board of examination and issuance of provisional licenses. The provisional license fee currently set by board rule is $75, and according to the board, there are currently 440 provisional licensees.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions
